reply_text:
I replied to Pree in her thread in #central-random. The brain now has 3 April as the deadline for the signed Tansley Parcel order form. That entry is marked as her correction to the 25 August date from her #central-team post this morning.

The old 25 August entry is still in the brain. I tried to remove it twice, but both times the brain said no fact with that number exists, even though it still shows up when I look up the account. The new entry says it replaces the old one, but anyone looking up Tansley Parcel will still see both dates. If the old one needs to go, someone with admin access to the brain will have to remove it.

I haven't checked either date against the order form itself, because I couldn't see any Tansley Parcel account files. As she asked, I did nothing beyond updating the record.
